issues.title: Three different minus characters for negative money
issues.detail: Insights trend copy mixes hyphen-minus, en dash and the true minus sign for negative amounts on the same screen, next to headline figures that use U+2212.
issues.evidence: Re-measured on /insights/overview (codepoint before the $): "−$870,358" U+2212; "-$2,970.23 YTD" U+002D; "-$303k" U+002D; "–$45.2k/mo" U+2013. Table amounts ("−$1,234.56") use U+2212. Independently confirmed with the Chrome DevTools MCP: the summary text node (class _bodyDefault_qaod7_40) starts with U+002D, while the KPI "−$870,358" (class _titleSecondary_qaod7_20) uses U+2212.

issues.title: Inconsistent K/k abbreviations and precision in Insights
issues.detail: The same paragraph abbreviates thousands as both "K" and "k" and switches between abbreviated, whole-dollar and cent precision.
issues.evidence: Trend text read via innerText: "$334.5K", "$33.4K", "$269.6K" vs "–$45.2k/mo", "-$303k"; headline "$1M" / "$1.9M" vs "−$870,358" (no cents) vs "-$2,970.23" (cents). Independently confirmed with the Chrome DevTools MCP: one sentence reads "Spending was -$303k … it was $33.4K".

issues.title: Summary totals and table amounts use different money components
issues.detail: On /transactions the Net change / Money in / Money out totals render cents at full size, while every table amount uses superscript cents. Two separate money components with different cent treatment sit on one screen.
issues.evidence: Table amount: div._dollarDisplay_1of3b_3 15px/400 with span._superscript_1of3b_35 ".56" at 10.95px. Money in total: div._container_7q9r6_1 (animated _digitSlot_7q9r6_11 spans) 19px/400 rgb(119,197,153), no superscript element. DevTools MCP: the Money in/out card shows the same quantity at three precisions: "$1.9M" (24px titleSecondary), "$1,909,616" (16px total) and "$1,000,000.00" (15px rows).

issues.title: Zero subtotals drop the cents format
issues.detail: Grouped view shows zero money-in subtotals as "$0" with no cents and larger text, while every sibling subtotal uses superscript cents.
issues.evidence: Grouped by Category: Legal Fees / Travel - Accommodation / Investments money in render "$0" (div._dollarDisplay_1of3b_3, 15px/400, rgb(221,221,229), no superscript span). Software money in renders "$2,608,874.96" with span._superscript_1of3b_35 ".96" at 10.95px.

issues.title: Failed incoming payments still use the money-in green
issues.detail: A failed incoming payment is struck through but keeps the positive green used for completed deposits, so it reads as money received. Failed outgoing payments use neutral white.
issues.evidence: "Payment from NASA — Failed $419.00": _text-money-in_12t49_1, color rgb(119,197,153), same as the successful "Payment from Acme Corp $200.00". Failed "Debug LLC −$450.50": _text-emphasized_12t49_1, rgb(244,245,249).

issues.title: Mixed Title Case and sentence case in the same menu
issues.detail: The ACH panel overflow menu lists "View Recipient" next to "Nickname recipient". The card panel menu says "Nickname sender". Elsewhere Mercury uses sentence case.
issues.evidence: ACH panel footer menu items read via [role=menuitem]: "View Recipient | Nickname recipient".

issues.title: "Money In" vs "Money in" for the same concept
issues.detail: Insights uses Title Case "Money In"/"Money Out" in the cashflow radio menu, filter chip and chart legend, but sentence case "Money in"/"Money out" in headings, tabs and the Transactions summary.
issues.evidence: Cashflow radios: "All Cashflow | Money In | Money Out"; page text on /insights/overview contains both "Money in"/"Money out" (headline labels, sidebar) and "Money In"/"Money Out" (radios, chip, Sankey node).

issues.title: Title Case dialog titles and buttons among sentence-case siblings
issues.detail: "Insights Settings", "Rename View" and the "Remove 2 Exclusions" button use Title Case, while sibling dialogs and buttons use sentence case ("Export transactions", "Save view", "Create category", "Exclude"). The headings share one style, so only the casing differs.
issues.evidence: Headings, all Arcadia Text 19px/400 rgb(255,255,255): SPAN._titleSecondary_qaod7_20 "Insights Settings"; H2 "Rename View"; _titleSecondary "Create category". Exclusions action button after selecting rows: "Remove 2 Exclusions" next to "Cancel"; before, "Exclude".

issues.title: Keyword filter named differently in Transactions and Insights
issues.detail: The Transactions filter tab and toolbar chip say "Keyword"; the Insights filter panel says "Keywords". The two filter panels also have different tab sets and only the Transactions one has a header row with the view summary.
issues.evidence: Insights [role=tab] list: Cashflow, Date, Keywords, Method, Category, GL Code, Account, Team Member, Department, Budget, Card (+ Exclusions button). Transactions tabs: Date, Keyword, Amount, Method, Category, Merchant Type, GL Code, Account, Team Member, Department, Budget, Card, Status, Policy, Attachment.

issues.title: Export action styled differently on Transactions and Insights
issues.detail: Transactions uses a transparent tertiary "Export all" button in the toolbar row. Insights uses a filled secondary "Export" pill in the page header.
issues.evidence: Transactions "Export all": _button_r6b2u_20 _small_r6b2u_72 _tertiary_r6b2u_153, background rgba(0,0,0,0). Insights "Export": _small_r6b2u_72 _secondary_r6b2u_126, background rgba(180,183,200,0.12). Both 13.33px/360 Arcadia Text, rgb(221,221,229), radius 9999px, padding 4px 16px 4px 12px, 32px tall.

issues.title: Panel category dropdown overflows the panel and the comment composer
issues.detail: In the transaction side panel the Category listbox runs past the panel's right edge and down onto the sticky comment composer, so "+ Create category" sits on top of the "Add a comment" field.
issues.evidence: incomingDomesticWire-1, dropdown open: listbox rect x 1056-1432, y 430-680, z-index 4; side panel container (radius 24px) x 988-1412; "Create category" option y 658-690; comment composer (contenteditable) y 667-707.

issues.title: Bar chart labels truncated to six letters

issues.title: Drill-down date chip says "All time" for a Jun 17–Today range

issues.title: Insights Export finishes with no confirmation
issues.detail: The Insights Export button shows a loading pill, then returns to "Export" with no toast or message, while other actions in the area confirm with a toast ("View saved", "View deleted", "2 transactions excluded").
issues.evidence: Button _button_r6b2u_20 _secondary_r6b2u_126 shows three-dot loader right after click; 3 s later its innerText is "Export" again and no [role=status]/[role=alert] text appears. Same-area toasts: "View deleted" + Undo, "View renamed" + Undo, "2 transactions excluded".
